watches.name: The Aurelian
watches.description: The Aurelian draws its spirit from Marcus Aurelius - not the emperor of conquest, but the man of discipline, restraint, and inner order. It is a watch shaped by the same philosophy he recorded in Meditations : remove what is unnecessary, focus on what endures, and let purpose guide every detail. The design reflects that ethos. The case is balanced and unadorned, defined by proportion rather than decoration. Finishes are deliberate - brushed surfaces for honesty, polished edges for clarity - nothing added without reason, nothing left unresolved. It wears close to the wrist, grounded and composed, as if it has always belonged there. The dial follows the same discipline. Clear, legible, and free of distraction, it favors function over flourish. Subtle depth and texture emerge only with time, rewarding attention without demanding it. It is a surface designed to be used, not admired from a distance. Inside, a reliable mechanical movement keeps steady time...quietly, consistently, without spectacle. Like the Stoic ideal, it does its work without complaint, built for longevity rather than display. The Aurelian is not a tribute in the superficial sense. It does not borrow symbols or imitate antiquity. Instead, it reflects a way of thinking...measured, intentional, and enduring. A watch for those who understand that true refinement is not added, but revealed through discipline. Because of the random nature of marble stone, no two dials will look alike. This is a desirable feature of all Eylandt marble dials, not a flaw. Your watch will be unique and the only one of it's kind in the world. • Movement: Seiko Epson YN55A (automatic & manual wind, hacking second hand, 21,600 bph, 22 jewels, 40 hour power reserve, bi-directional rotor) • Case: 316L stainless steel, brushed & polished • Case Width: 40 mm • Case Thickness: 13 mm (w/domed crystal) • Lug Width: 20 mm • Lug to Lug: 48 mm • Caseback: Screwdown, engraved • Dial: genuine Marble w/Swiss Superluminova BGW9 applied markers • Front Crystal: Domed sapphire w/AR coating • Water Resistance: 200 meters • Crown: Signed, screw down • Bezel: Polished • Bracelet: 316L stainless steel, link, signed, slide clasp adjust, solid & curved female end links

watches.name: The Hemel Air Wing
watches.description: Air Wing Mechanical Chronograph – Heritage and Versatility The Hemel Air Wing blends vintage aviation and racing chronograph design into a highly wearable mechanical timepiece. Powered by the ST19 hand‑winding chronograph movement with swan‑neck regulator, this watch delivers satisfying mechanical timing performance with a respectable 45‑hour power reserve and crisp chronograph actuation. Classic Design with Practical Utility At the heart of the Air Wing is a classic chronograph dial, inspired by mid‑century pilot and military timepieces, offering immediate legibility of elapsed minutes and running seconds. Its 120‑click rotating bezel adds functional versatility for timing and dual‑time tracking, while Super‑Luminova C3 lume ensures visibility in low light. Balanced Dimensions and Everyday Comfort Housed in a 316L stainless steel case with a comfortable 40 mm case, the Air Wing strikes an ideal balance between tool‑watch presence and everyday wearability. A double‑domed sapphire crystal with anti‑reflective coating protects the dial, and an exhibition‑style screw‑down caseback showcases the finely finished ST19 movement beneath. Craftsmanship Meets Functional Design From its lumed markers and bold subdial layout to its rotating bezel and exhibition back, the Air Wing embodies mechanical integrity and purposeful design. Whether paired with leather for office wear or sported in active settings, it’s a vintage‑inspired aviation chronograph that transitions seamlessly across daily missions and formal occasions. watches.name: Sky Racer / Automatic
watches.description: Reference HF Series The Sky Racer chronograph watch was engineered around the SL4617 automatic chronograph movement, a modern integrated mechanical chronograph designed to deliver dependable performance and everyday durability. Often compared to the ETA / Valjoux 7750, the SL4617 follows a similar philosophy: a robust, no-nonsense automatic chronograph architecture optimized for reliability, serviceability, and consistent operation. While the 7750 is widely regarded as the industry benchmark for integrated automatic chronographs, the SL4617 offers a contemporary alternative that prioritizes functional equivalence over heritage branding. It provides the familiar chronograph layout, solid winding efficiency, and dependable timekeeping expected by enthusiasts, making it well suited for aviation-inspired and tool-watch chronographs. The Sky Racer houses this movement within a bold cushion-case chronograph design, paired with a clean, functional panda dial elevated by an unexpected sandpaper-textured finish. Thoughtfully executed details throughout the case and dial reinforce the watch’s purpose-driven design. Drawing inspiration from classic aviation chronographs, the Sky Racer blends mechanical credibility, tool-watch functionality, and modern microbrand design innovation into a distinctive and mechanically honest chronograph. Why SL4617 Instead of a 7750? The SL4617 automatic chronograph movement delivers the same core benefits enthusiasts associate with the ETA / Valjoux 7750—an integrated chronograph design, robust construction, and reliable everyday performance—without the cost premium tied to heritage branding. By choosing the SL4617, we were able to focus resources on case construction, dial execution, and overall build quality, resulting in a better-balanced chronograph at this price point. For wearers, the experience is straightforward: solid mechanical performance, dependable chronograph operation, and long-term serviceability, without paying extra for a name on the movement bridge. • Movement: Peacock SL4617 (7750 clone). It incorporates a tachymeter scale, a jumbo crown, and a black Italian leather strap, marking firsts for the collection while maintaining Hemel’s signature purpose-driven aesthetic. Big-Feature Layout – Precision and Legibility The Air Strike’s dial is thoughtfully arranged to maximize clarity and usability, with oversized subdials and a bold tachymeter scale that emphasize its timing capabilities. Every element from the jumbo crown to the strap reinforces mechanical precision and functional design, offering a tactile experience reminiscent of classic pilot and racing chronographs. Durable, Wearable, Everyday Ready Designed for daily missions, the Air Strike pairs accessibly priced hand-wound chronograph movement with durable case construction and a comfortable Italian leather strap. Its refined proportions and clean dial layout make it effortlessly wearable, whether on the wrist of a collector, enthusiast, or adventurer. Heritage and Innovation Combined By blending traditional chronograph craftsmanship with modern microbrand design innovation, the Air Strike delivers a timeless, heirloom-quality pilot chronograph. It’s a versatile watch that embodies durability, precision, and style, making it perfect for both aviation-inspired enthusiasts and those seeking a functional, mechanically honest timepiece. • Movement: ST19. watches.name: The Hemel Air Defense
watches.description: Reference HF Series Air Defense Hand-Winding Chronograph – Precision Meets Style The Hemel Air Defense reinterprets a classic pilot and racing chronograph aesthetic, offering a more open and legible piano black dial. Simplified markers create breathing room for oversized subdials, highlighting the watch’s mechanical timing capabilities and hand-wound craftsmanship. Big-Subdial Romance – Classic Timing at a Glance The Air Defense features a big-subdial layout, giving instant clarity for timing functions while evoking the charm of vintage hand-wound chronographs from aviation and motorsport history. Every glance at the dial is a reminder of precision engineering, purposeful design, and horological heritage. Design Details – Ready for Every Adventure Equipped with piston pushers and a double-signed buckle, the Air Defense pairs perfectly with its flexible Italian leather strap, delivering comfort for any wrist. From the pushers to the strap, every detail reinforces functionality, durability, and classic style, making this chronograph ready for both everyday wear and adventurous pursuits. Heritage-Inspired Innovation By combining traditional hand-wound movement craftsmanship with modern microbrand design innovation, the Air Defense balances mechanical integrity, legibility, and aesthetic appeal. It’s a versatile pilot chronograph that appeals to collectors, enthusiasts, and anyone seeking a refined, purpose-built timepiece. • Movement: ST19. watches.name: The Hemel Airfoil
watches.description: Reference HF Series Airfoil Pilot Chronograph with ST19 Mechanical Movement The Hemel Airfoil redefines what a modern pilot chronograph watch can be, powered by the ST19 column-wheel mechanical chronograph movement. Known for its precision and reliability, the ST19 is a movement celebrated among vintage chronograph enthusiasts and microbrand collectors alike. Vintage 1970s British Military Inspiration The Airfoil’s dial design takes direct cues from 1970s British military pilot watches, combining a thoughtfully appointed layout, a narrow bezel, and a slender strap for a refined, sophisticated profile. Every detail is designed to evoke classic aviation heritage while remaining wearable in a contemporary setting. Full-Lume Aged Ivory Colored Dial Our aged ivory colored dial is a full-lume pilot dial, offering excellent legibility in low-light conditions while maintaining vintage charm. Polished case finishes, precise chronograph subdials, and meticulous detailing make the Airfoil a microbrand watch that balances heritage, craftsmanship, and modern design innovation. Why Collectors Love the Airfoil ST19 mechanical chronograph: integrated column-wheel movement with smooth operation Aviation-inspired design: vintage British military cues, narrow bezel, full-lume dial Refined finish: polished case, slender strap options, and detailed craftsmanship • Movement: ST19. watches.name: The Hemel Air League Special
watches.description: Reference HF Series Air League Special – Pilot Chronograph with Vintage Spirit The Hemel Air League Special presents a refined take on classic pilot chronographs, combining heritage pilot watch design with modern mechanical craftsmanship. Developed with insights from enthusiast communities, this chronograph is powered by the Seagull ST19 hand‑winding movement with an optional swan‑neck regulator, delivering mechanical precision, satisfying tactile actuation, and a 45‑hour power reserve prized by mechanical watch enthusiasts. Classic Chronograph Dial – Legible and Functional Under a double‑domed sapphire crystal with anti‑reflective coating, the Air League’s matte black dial is treated with Super‑Luminova C3, ensuring outstanding legibility in low light. Its clean dial layout and lumed markers evoke mid‑century aviation instruments, while the 120‑click rotating ceramic bezel adds functional timing versatility and subtle visual contrast. Balanced Dimensions and Everyday Wearability Housed in a 316L stainless steel case with a comfortable 40 mm diameter and ~13.4 mm thickness, the Air League is sized for everyday wear. The exhibition screw‑down caseback showcases the finely finished ST19 movement, and the signed crown and push‑pull chronograph pushers reinforce its purposeful pilot character. With 100 meters water resistance, it’s built to withstand daily missions without needless fuss. Heritage Meets Function – A Timeless Microbrand Chronograph By combining traditional chronograph movement craftsmanship with classic aviation design cues, the Air League Special delivers a timeless pilot chronograph that appeals to enthusiasts and everyday wearers alike. Its blend of mechanical integrity, legibility, and durable construction makes it a standout piece in the Hemel lineup and a compelling choice for anyone seeking a mechanically honest, vintage‑inspired chronograph. • Movement: ST19.
